roleTitle: Credit Risk Data Analyst, Model Monitoring
jobDescription: A consumer lender with personal-loan and credit-card books is hiring a credit risk data analyst into its model monitoring team. The analyst builds the monthly scorecard monitoring, keeps the data lineage documentation for decisioning models current, prepares development samples for rebuilds and supports independent validation. The analyst also presents monitoring findings at the credit risk committee, whose members routinely challenge the numbers and ask for the drivers behind any deterioration, so presenters are expected to answer from the data rather than from summaries.
requirements: Builds monthly monitoring of scorecard performance (Gini, population stability, characteristic analysis).
Maintains the data lineage documentation for credit decisioning models.
Presents monitoring findings to the credit risk committee and responds to challenge.
Writes SQL and Python to prepare development samples for scorecard rebuilds.
Supports model validation by preparing evidence for the independent validation team.

evidence.text: Credit risk data analyst at Ashvale Finance (unsecured personal loans), September 2021 to present; built the monthly scorecard monitoring report covering Gini, population stability and characteristic analysis for the application scorecard.
Wrote the SQL and Python that assembles development samples for scorecard rebuilds, including the bad-rate definition, the performance window and the exclusion logic.
Natural communicator and a trusted voice in the room; colleagues tell me I have a gift for making complex risk numbers feel simple to any audience.
Prepared the monitoring section of the monthly pack that the head of credit risk took to the credit risk committee.

Assembled the evidence folders (data dictionaries, sample counts, code) requested by the independent model validation team for the 2023 scorecard review, and answered the validators' data queries through the review tracker.

Work sample: an anonymised monitoring report for one quarter, with Gini by month, the population stability index against the development sample and characteristic analysis tables for the five highest-weight variables.

HR verification note: employment at Ashvale Finance since September 2021 and the job title Credit Risk Data Analyst were confirmed by the employer's HR team through the employment verification service.
